system.description:
A hallucinogenic blend of fear pheromones first made as a crowd-control payload for Needle weapons; it proved addictive, and repeated doses can leave lasting madness.

A dosed target rolls on the Shock Table at once. Each extra dose taken the same day adds a cumulative +1 to that roll (+1 for the second, +2 for the third, and so on).
system.effectText: Immediate Shock Table roll; each further dose that day adds +1 more to the roll.
